name: Dreamer Development
description: Three modules aimed at ease of use, ergonomics, accessibility and convenience: Clarity, Test Gear and Dark.
author: Chris Graham

modules.name: Dark
modules.description: Work in progress: attempts to synthesize a dark mode for modules whose makers ship only light panels. Currently works well for only a few module families, those used by the author. Done in memory — nothing is written, and switching it off with the panel button, or removing the module, puts every panel back.

modules.name: Clarity
modules.description: Ten individually selectable features for usability, accessibility and ergonomics: colour-coded ports and cables, cable tracing, click to add and move cables, one knob style with value arcs, larger high-contrast tooltips, and more.

modules.name: Test Gear
modules.description: Fourteen "widgets" that clip onto any port from its right-click menu and take up no rack space: oscilloscope, spectrum analyser, audio monitor, voltmeter, frequency meter, mute, attenuverter, and generators for gates, clocks, noise and tones. A convenient, lightweight way to tweak and understand your patches.
